sections.content: Use *¿Quieres* + infinitive? to invite someone: *¿Quieres venir a la fiesta?* You know *querer* and *poder* from Unit 10, so you can also ask *¿Puedes* + infinitive? to check that the person is free: *¿Puedes venir el sábado?* To accept, say *Sí, claro* and add *Quiero ir* or *Puedo ir*. Keep the invitation focused on the event, time or activity.

items.english: Do you want to come to the party?
Yes, of course. I want to go.
Yes, of course. I can go.

sections.content: *¿Quieres venir?* asks whether the person wants to come; *¿Puedes venir?* asks whether they are free. Both are friendly invitations, and *Sí, claro* answers either one.
